chunks: Yunus, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The penalty (hadd) regarding wine is established whether a little or much is drunk from it.'

Then he (Abu Abdillah) said: 'Umar was brought Qudamah ibn Maz'un, who had drunk wine, and the proof was established upon him. So he asked Ali (peace be upon him), who ordered that he be whipped eighty (lashes).'
Qudamah said: 'O Amir al-Mu'minin! There is no penalty upon me; I am among those rightful for this Verse: "On those who believe and do righteous deeds, there is no blame for what they eat."'
So Ali (peace be upon him) said: 'You are not among its rightful ones. The food of its rightful ones is permissible to them; they do not eat or drink except what Allah has permitted to them.'
Then Ali (peace be upon him) said: 'The drinker, when he drinks, does not know what he eats or what he drinks.' So they whipped him eighty lashes.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْآيَةِ: Those entitled to the specific ruling of the Verse
key_terms.الْبَيِّنَةُ: The proof or evidence establishing the fact
key_terms.الْحَدُّ: The fixed legal penalty prescribed by Sharia
key_terms.قُدَامَةُ بْنُ مَظْعُونٍ: A companion of the Prophet known for his piety

ai.seo_question: What is the legal penalty for drinking wine in Shia jurisprudence and how did Imam Ali interpret the Quranic verse regarding it?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of *kaff* (consistency) in the penalty for wine, ruling that the hadd applies regardless of quantity, a view strongly supported by Shia jurists. It recounts the historical incident where Umar ibn al-Khattab consulted Imam Ali regarding Qudamah ibn Maz'un, who cited Quran 5:93 to claim exemption for his past consumption. Imam Ali refuted this by distinguishing between the general exemption for past sins and the specific state of intoxication, noting that the drinker loses rational control (*'aql*), thereby incurring the penalty.

en.hubeali: Yunus, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,
‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The Penalty (Hadd) (would be established) regarding the wine, if it is drunk from it, a little or more’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They came to Umar with Qadamat Bin Mazoun, and he had drunk the wine, and the proof was established upon him. So he (Umar) asked Ali<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> ordered that he should be whipped eighty (lashes).

So Qadamat said, ‘O Amir Al-Momineenasws! There is no Penalty (Hadd) upon me. I am from the ones rightful of this Verse [5:93] On those who believe and do righteous deeds there is no blame for what they eat’.

So Ali<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You are not from its rightful ones. The food of its rightful ones is Permissible unto them. They are not eating and drinking excep what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Permitted to them’.
Then Ali<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The drinker, when he drinks (wine), he does not know what he eats and what he drinks’. So he<sup>asws</sup> whipped him eighty lashes’.
